notes: Prismatic Lattice Shield, 4x4: a gem-cut violet frame round two nested diamond lattices (two layers) of thin cyan lines with a node on every crossing and a big faceted crystal in the middle; light chases along the lattice lines and the nodes flash magenta in turn (the 6-frame loop). Off: dark grey lattice and a dull crystal. Damaged: a lattice line snapped and a node dark, a facet cracked, the light stutters. Disabled: the lattice broken and dull, the crystal split.
